name: UST_Phase1_Releases_(CNFA_View)
title: UST_Phase1_Releases (CNFA View)
description: This layer shows Underground Storage Tank Facilities with confirmed releases that were issued a Conditional No Further Action decision. Contaminants are above RBSLs (Risk Based Screening Levels) but below SSTLs (Site Specific Target Levels). A copy of RBSLs used by the UST Management Division are available in Appendix D of the Quality Assurance Program Plan for the Underground Storage Tank Management Division found on the Agency's website. SSTLs are calculated for an individual site by the Division using site specific data.
